finishedText:
Case Note Date: 12/11

Present at the visit were Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea. 

During the visit, it was observed that mould has appeared in the back bedroom again and is worse by the window. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes reported that the landlord has not replied to two emails. In addition, Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed a benefits form deadline. A letter is available, and the date of birth on the form is 3/3/87.

It was agreed that I will ring the landlord on Monday. It was also agreed that Maria Okonkwo-Reyes posts the form on Friday. Tomas Brandvold, who is a neighbour and also on my list, offered to help her with the form.

The identified risk is rent arrears if the form is late.

The next steps are to revisit on 26/11.
